mapper.sql: SELECT A.sys09_code_id AS code_id, A.sys09_company_id AS company_id, A.sys09_code_kind_id AS code_kind_id, A.sys09_code AS code, A.sys09_name AS name, A.sys09_seq AS seq, COALESCE(A.sys09_close_yn = 'true', false) AS close_yn, A.sys09_apply_date::date AS apply_date, A.sys09_close_date::date AS close_date, ( SELECT (MIN(X.sys09_apply_date) - INTERVAL '1 DAY')::date FROM sys09_code X WHERE 1=1 AND X.sys09_company_id = A.sys09_company_id AND X.sys09_code_kind_id = A.sys09_code_kind_id AND X.sys09_code = A.sys09_code AND X.sys09_apply_date > A.sys09_apply_date ) AS last_date, A.sys09_note AS note FROM sys09_code A
mapper.select: INNER JOIN sys08_code_kind ON sys08_code_kind_id = sys09_code_kind_id WHERE 1=1 AND A.sys09_code_kind_id = #{codeKindId} AND A.sys09_company_id = CASE WHEN sys08_sys_yn = 'true' THEN 0 ELSE #{companyId} END AND CONCAT(A.sys09_code, A.sys09_name) ILIKE '%'||#{searchText}||'%' ORDER BY A.sys09_seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys09_code (sys09_code_id, sys09_company_id, sys09_code_kind_id, sys09_code, sys09_name, sys09_seq, sys09_close_yn, sys09_apply_date, sys09_close_date, sys09_note) VALUES (#{codeId}, #{companyId}, #{codeKindId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{seq}, #{closeYn}, #{applyDate}, #{closeDate}, #{note})

INSERT INTO sys09_code (sys09_code_id, sys09_code, sys09_name, sys09_seq, sys09_note, sys09_apply_date, sys09_close_yn, sys09_code_kind_id, sys09_company_id, sys09_close_date, sys09_desc) SELECT f_create_seq(), sys09_code, sys09_name, sys09_seq, sys09_note, sys09_apply_date, sys09_close_yn, sys09_code_kind_id, #{newCompanyId}, sys09_close_date, sys09_desc FROM sys09_code WHERE sys09_company_id = #{targetCompanyId} AND sys09_code_kind_id = #{codeKindId}

INSERT INTO sys09_code (sys09_code_id, sys09_code, sys09_name, sys09_seq, sys09_note, sys09_apply_date, sys09_close_yn, sys09_code_kind_id, sys09_company_id, sys09_close_date, sys09_desc) SELECT f_create_seq(), sys09_code, sys09_name, sys09_seq, sys09_note, sys09_apply_date, sys09_close_yn, sys09_code_kind_id, #{companyId}, NULL, sys09_desc FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code ON sys08_code_kind_id = sys09_code_kind_id WHERE 1=1 AND sys08_sys_yn = 'false' AND sys09_company_id = 0
mapper.select: , sys08_code_kind k WHERE sys08_code_kind_id = A.sys09_code_kind_id AND ( ( COALESCE(sys08_sys_yn,'false') = 'true' AND A.sys09_company_id = 0 ) OR ( COALESCE(sys08_sys_yn,'false') != 'true' AND A.sys09_company_id = #{companyId} ) ) AND sys08_kind_cd = #{kindCd} AND ( ( COALESCE(A.sys09_close_yn ,'false') = 'true' AND COALESCE(A.sys09_close_date,'1900-12-31') >= #{applyDate}::date ) OR ( COALESCE(A.sys09_close_yn ,'false') = 'false' ) ) AND A.sys09_apply_date = ( SELECT max(x.sys09_apply_date) FROM sys09_code x WHERE x.sys09_code_kind_id = A.sys09_code_kind_id AND x.sys09_company_id = A.sys09_company_id AND x.sys09_code = A.sys09_code AND x.sys09_apply_date <= #{applyDate}::date ) ORDER BY A.sys09_seq
